q1_issues.issue: 'all day' is rendered as an exact one-day duration measure, inventing a magnitude the text never states (the only vague-duration rule provided is the bare-plural MeasureAtLeast ... 2 form).

'leave the lights on' preserves rather than causes the on-state, so the Result link — and with it the resultative recipe's Patient at index 3 — over-reads a rule whose own guidance is to omit Result when causation is unclear.

q2_gaps: whole-span durative adverbial 'all day / all night / all week' — only counted durations, bare-plural durations, intervals (Start/End) and frequencies (Every/TimesPer) are addressed

a separated particle that is also a state predicate ('leave the lights on', 'switch the lights on') — no test decides between the phrasal-verb symbol (leave_on) and the resultative secondary-predicate encoding
notes: The definite plural correctly becomes a group witness with its property attached by Member, and the reified-state-plus-flat-atom dual emit follows the state-resultative recipe exactly. Whether the duration belongs on the leave event or on the reified on-state is a further open question the instruction set does not settle.
